Start date: 1245-09-04  
39 weeks = 39 × 7 = 273 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 274 days.  

1245 is not a leap year (divisible by 5? No, 1245 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
Days from Sep 4 to end of 1245:  
Sep (30-4=26) + Oct 31 + Nov 30 + Dec 31 = 118 days.  

274 − 118 = 156 days into 1246.  
1246 is not leap (1246 mod 4 = 2).  
Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 = 90 days.  
156 − 90 = 66 days into April.  
April has 30 days → 66 − 30 = 36 days into May.  
May has 31 days → 36 − 31 = 5 days into June.  

So June 5, 1246.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1246-06-05
